app.name: Headliner
app.tagline: Know whether the room makes sense before you sign the guarantee.
app.sampleBanner: Sample mode: illustrative evidence, no Qloo key

desk.title: Check a deal
desk.intro: Type the offer the way it arrives. The arithmetic is deterministic, Qloo supplies the audience evidence, and nothing is forecast.
desk.placeholder: Artist · City · 300 cap · $28 ticket · $3,500 guarantee + $1,200 room
desk.offersNote: Acts and cities are real. Offer terms are illustrative deal shapes, not claims about any act's fees.
desk.missing: Could not read: {{fields}}. Add them to the line; the desk does not guess.
desk.baselineToggle: Also run it without Qloo and measure the overlap
desk.suiteLink: See the API calls behind a check
desk.empty: Type an offer above or pick one from the offers list.
desk.enterHint: Enter to check, Shift+Enter for a new line

verdict.cells: Mean Qloo affinity rank across {{count}} map cells (0 to 1)

cannot.competing_shows_same_night: Competing shows on the same night
cannot.actual_ticket_sales: Actual ticket sales (affinity is evidence, not a forecast)
cannot.venue_hold_status: Whether the venue hold is still open

suite.title: API status
suite.intro: Runs every Qloo endpoint Headliner depends on, once, against one well-known act, and shows status, latency and result counts. With a key these are live calls.

auth.resetSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm the account, then sign in.
auth.disabled: Accounts are not configured on this deployment. The desk works without one.
auth.error: That did not work. Check the details and try again.
auth.why: An account saves your checks and lets you share a verdict with a co-promoter. Running a check never needs one.
auth.deleteHelp: Email {{email}} from your account address with the subject "Delete my account" and it is done within 7 days.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Headliner is operated by one person; email is answered within two working days.
support.a1: No. The deal math is arithmetic on the numbers you type. Qloo affinity is cultural evidence about an act's audience in a place. Neither is a forecast, and the result lists what the check cannot establish.
support.a2: Without a Qloo key the desk shows clearly labelled sample evidence so the flow can be tried. Nothing in sample mode comes from Qloo.
support.a3: No. Accounts save checks and share verdicts; running a check is open to everyone.
support.a4: To the server for the check, then to Qloo as entity and city names. Offer lines are not stored unless you save them to an account.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: For anything about Headliner, the hackathon entry, or a partnership.
contact.sent: Sent. You will hear back within two working days.

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.intro: Same arithmetic, same evidence calls, one change.
scenario.close: Back to the offer as written

board.title: Offers
board.intro: Every pre-seeded offer in one list. Run them all and each row fills in with its result.

story.title: How a check works
story.intro: Three columns, kept strictly apart. A promoter can trust each one for what it is.

money.title: Economics are arithmetic
money.body: Break-even, net per ticket and net at sellout come from arithmetic against a versioned rulebook. No model touches a dollar figure, and the rulebook version is stamped on every verdict.

taste.title: Audience is evidence
taste.body: Qloo supplies the cultural read: the act resolved to an entity, affinity across the metro's heatmap cells, who the audience is, which local acts share it, which brands they already buy. Every call is on the back panel.

unknown.title: Limits are stated
unknown.body: Competing shows, radius clauses, actual sales, the hold, the date. The desk lists what no signal can establish, and it abstains out loud when the signal itself is missing.

scenario.title: Change one thing
scenario.body: Swap the market, put the opener on the bill, apply a sponsor offset. The same check runs again and the two verdicts sit side by side with exactly what moved and why.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceHelp: Light is the default. Dark keeps the cream readings on a dark panel.
settings.notificationsHelp: Account mail (confirmation, password reset) always sends. These are the optional ones.
settings.notifyVerdictHelp: A copy of each verdict you share, with its link. Coming once shares can be saved to an account.
settings.notifyProductHelp: Rare, plain, from headliner@carsonrodrigues.com. Unsubscribe here any time.

status.signed_out: Your session ended. Sign in again.

settings.exportHelp: Everything Headliner holds about you, as one JSON file: account, settings, and the verdicts you shared while signed in.
settings.deleteHelp: Removes your account from the sign-in service and retires your settings and shared links. Shared links stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.

home.title: Check a show offer before you sign it
home.subtitle: Paste the offer line. The money is arithmetic, the audience evidence comes from Qloo, and the unknowns are named.
